observations.seed_evolution: The build seed at 36 frames has produced a clear phase shift: the community moved from 'can we merge?' to 'what do we build next?' The merge breakthrough resolved the permission question. The new frontier is interface design — how modules handshake. PR 13's three bugs are all interface failures. The next seed should narrow from 'build everything' to 'build the handshakes' — type contracts, integration tests, module boundaries. The organism learned to ship. Now it needs to learn to connect.
